name: Geir Engdahl
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, AI, Cognite (Oslo)
profile: Norwegian technologist who co-founded industrial-data/AI software company Cognite in 2016 with John Markus Lervik and others. Previously founded ML classifieds startup Snapsale (acquired by Schibsted in 2017) and was a senior software engineer at Google. Served as Cognite CTO, then Chief Product Officer (2024), and was named CTO, AI in May 2025.
interesting_fact: Before Cognite he founded Snapsale (2011), a machine-learning classifieds startup he ran as CEO/CTO until Schibsted acquired it in 2017.
deep_cut_fact: He won a silver medal at the International Olympiad in Informatics, and holds a master's in computational science from the University of Oslo.
notes: Press contact is Cognite's VP Global PR (Michelle Holford) as listed in 2024 release; may have changed. Role update: https://itbrief.co.uk/story/cognite-appoints-ai-leaders-to-drive-innovation-push

name: Matias Muchnick
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, NotCo (The Not Company)
profile: Chilean entrepreneur who co-founded NotCo in 2015 with Karim Pichara and Pablo Zamora, using its AI 'Giuseppe' to formulate plant-based foods (NotMilk, NotMayo); backed by Jeff Bezos' fund and valued at ~$1.5B+. In 2025-26 NotCo pivoted toward selling its AI formulation platform to food majors (Kraft Heinz JV, Ferrero, Coca-Cola), exiting several consumer markets.
interesting_fact: Named to TIME's Next Generation Leaders; NotCo attracted investors including Bezos Expeditions and Roger Federer.
deep_cut_fact: Before NotCo he left finance to launch Eggless, a vegan mayonnaise brand in Chile; earlier still his first startup, a gamified-wellness app called Chooz, was in his words 'a total failure'.
notes: Active on LinkedIn and frequent podcast guest. No published press email found in quick search; go via NotCo comms (notco.com).
